title: Coarse Solvers for Exascale Solution of Poisson Problems
summary: We present a two-level Schwarz method as an alternative to Algebraic Multigrid method(AMG) used as the last level (coarse) solver of the p-multigrid pMG preconditioner for pressure Poisson equation resulting from Spectral/Finite element descretization of incompressible Navier-Stokes equation. Proposed Schwarz method consits of a local problem in the original pMG coarse space and a global coarse problem.
